article.headline: No. 24 Michigan State women beat No. 15 Ole Miss 66-49 to win Cherokee Invitational
article.description: — Rashunda Jones scored eight of her 13 points in a decisive third quarter, Grace VanSlooten finished with a double-double, and No. 24 Michigan State beat No. 15 Mississippi 66-49 on Monday night in the Cherokee Invitational title game.
article.linkText: No. 24 Michigan State women beat No. 15 Ole Miss 66-49 to win Cherokee Invitational

categories.description: Michigan State Spartans @ Ole Miss Rebels

event.description: Michigan State Spartans @ Ole Miss Rebels

keywords: Michigan State Spartans @ Ole Miss Rebels
article.story: CHEROKEE, N.C. -- — Rashunda Jones scored eight of her 13 points in a decisive third quarter, Grace VanSlooten finished with a double-double, and No. 24 Michigan State beat No. 15 Mississippi 66-49 on Monday night in the Cherokee Invitational title game. Michigan State led 26-20 at the break and scored the first four points of the third quarter. Ole Miss cut the deficit to 30-25, but the Spartans closed on a 17-7 run for a 49-32 advantage heading into the final quarter. Jones hit a pair of 3s and Kennedy Blair scored all of her seven points in the third quarter for the Spartans, who shot 69% (9 of 13) in the period. VanSlooten finished with 16 points, 10 rebounds and three assists. Isaline Alexander added 12 points for Michigan State (11-1). Cotie McMahon scored 13 points to lead led Ole Miss (12-2), which shot 33% (17 of 51) overall and missed 15 of its 17 shots from long range. Michigan State routed Indiana State 115-66 and Ole Miss beat Old Dominion 86-57 in Sunday's tournament games. Up next Michigan State: Hosts Rutgers on Sunday. Ole Miss: Plays at home against Alcorn State on Sunday. ------ Get poll alerts and updates on the AP Top 25 throughout the season. Sign up here.
